title: CoCoNet: Convex Conformal Network for Multi-Dimensional Uncertainty Regions
abstract: arXiv:2610.24246v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees under exchangeability, but the efficiency of its prediction regions depends critically on the choice of the conformity score. This is particularly important in multivariate regression, where dependencies across output dimensions induce complex joint uncertainty structures. This paper introduces CoCoNet (Convex Conformal Network) for learning conformity scores that induce flexible and data-adaptive prediction regions. The main mechanism is an input-dependent convex score learned end-to-end: CoCoNet trains the score on held-out data by directly minimizing the size of its sublevel sets, while enforcing convexity with respect to the residual so that every prediction region is inherently convex. translated_abstract: 保形预测（CP）在可交换性假设下提供无分布的覆盖率保证，但其预测区域的效率在很大程度上取决于一致性分数的选择。这一点在多变量回归中尤为重要，因为输出维度之间的依赖关系会产生复杂的联合不确定性结构。本文提出了 CoCoNet（Convex Conformal Network，凸保形网络），用于学习能够产生灵活且数据自适应预测区域的一致性分数。其核心机制是一个端到端学习的、依赖输入的凸分数：CoCoNet 通过直接最小化该分数子水平集的大小，在留出数据上进行训练，同时强制其相对于残差保持凸性，从而使每个预测区域天然为凸。随后，CoCoNet 应用分割保形校准以保留有限样本覆盖率保证。论文提出了该方法的两个变体：1）CoCoNet-Spline，基于
tldr: 提出 CoCoNet，通过端到端学习依赖输入的凸一致性分数并直接最小化其子水平集大小，生成灵活数据自适应的凸预测区域，同时借助分割保形校准保留有限样本覆盖率保证。
en_tdlr: CoCoNet learns input-dependent convex conformity scores end-to-end by minimizing sublevel set sizes while enforcing convexity, yielding flexible, data-adaptive convex prediction regions that retain finite-sample coverage guarantees via split-conformal calibration.
